title: Effective Techniques to Close Gym Sales | FLiiP

facts.fact: The FLiiP blog article 'Effective Techniques to Close More Sales at Your Gym or Fitness Studio' was published on April 18, 2024.
The page links to a related FLiiP article titled 'Overcoming 16 Common Sales Objections for Gyms and Fitness Studios'.
facts.quote: [Overcoming 16 Common Sales Objections for Gyms and Fitness Studios](https://myfliip.com/resources/blog/overcoming-16-common-sales-objections-for-gyms-and-fitness-studios)

facts.fact: FLiiP offers prospective customers a free demo of its platform for closing gym sales.
facts.quote: Want to learn more about leveraging FLiiPto close more sales? [Book a free demo!](https://myfliip.com/book-my-demo/)

facts.fact: In the page's 'Now or Never Close' example script, a gym offers an additional 10% discount on membership to prospects who sign up the same day, with the offer expiring by end of day.
facts.quote: If you sign up today, you’ll get an additional 10% discount on your membership. This offer expires by end of day.

facts.fact: In the page's 'Summary Close' example script, the illustrated membership includes access to all classes, 24/7 gym use, and one personal training session each month.
facts.quote: So, you’ll get access to all classes, 24/7 gym use, and a personal training session each month.

facts.fact: The page's 'Take Away Close' example script says only a couple of slots remain for a membership tier, which is an illustrative scarcity tactic rather than a reported figure.
facts.quote: We actually only have a couple of slots left for this membership tier, so I’d hate for you to miss out.

facts.fact: The page's 'Assumptive Close' example script proposes scheduling a first orientation session on either Monday or Wednesday.
facts.quote: Would Monday or Wednesday work better for you?
